clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in Thousand Needles, the Galak centaur guard the Cloven Hoof within a sacred flame at Splithoof Hold. Tauren scholars seek to understand the strange energy rising from the relic.

At the heart of Splithoof Hold, the Galak centaur keep the Cloven Hoof in an ancient brazier. Magical fire surrounds the relic, and blessed water must quench the flame for a moment before anyone can handle it. The centaur clans are divided and violent, yet their care for the brazier points to a ritual bound to their origins. At Freewind Post, Rau Cliffrunner and other tauren observers hope the strange aura of the hoof will teach them about the centaur who have long troubled Kalimdor's plains.
